title: Design System: DBX Native Data Console

title.purpose: DBX wordmark in the top bar.

body.purpose: Controls, fields, table labels, tabs, and editor text.

label.purpose: Metadata, panel detail, captions, and status.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary commits such as Connect, Run, and New connection.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; background: #3b82f6; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #60a5fa; border-color: #60a5fa; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #10294d; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Save, Test Connection, and Choose file. Test Connection validates current input without saving a profile, opening a workspace, or changing database state.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; background: #171a20; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #1f232b; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #171a20; border-color: #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: #0a0c10; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive database actions requiring deliberate confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; background: #171a20; color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #34191d; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #0a0c10; }

components.name: Connection Tab
components.description: Persistent primary tab for an open database connection; the active tab carries a full-width 2px Command Blue bottom indicator.
components.css: .ds-connection-tab { position: relative; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #111318; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #343b47; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-connection-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #3b82f6; } .ds-tab-db { color: #3b82f6; font-size: 16px; } .ds-connection-tab i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #22c55e; } .ds-tab-badge { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #171a20; color: #94a3b8; font: 500 10px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-close { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-connection-tab:hover .ds-tab-close { background: #171a20; } .ds-connection-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Native Text Field
components.description: Single-line connection, filter, and cell field treatment. Connection setup gives Details fields (host, port, user, password, database) and Connection String equal weight; SQLite uses a database-file field with a native Choose file action. Saving uses the user-visible name for profile and OS-keyring lookup, never profile JSON for passwords.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 7px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #0a0c10; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #343b47; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input::selection { background: #3311ff30; }

components.name: SQL Editor
components.description: Multiline query field with the built-in lexical color spectrum.
components.html:
SELECT sqlite_version();
-- Run with Cmd+Enter
components.css: .ds-sql-editor { height: 204px; padding: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: auto; background: #0a0c10; color: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #343b47; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-sql-editor:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-sql-keyword { color: #c792ea; } .ds-sql-identifier { color: #82aaff; } .ds-sql-comment { color: #6b7482; }

components.name: Explorer Entry
components.description: Compact schema explorer item for a table or view.
components.css: .ds-explorer-item { width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #10294d; color: #3b82f6; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font: 11px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-explorer-item span:first-child { font-size: 16px; } .ds-explorer-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-explorer-item:hover { background: #171a20; color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-explorer-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: SVG Line Icon
components.description: Embedded 16px database icon from DBX's compile-time SVG asset vocabulary, which includes dedicated Structure and Refresh glyphs; consuming controls provide its semantic color.

components.name: Connection Document Tabs
components.description: Per-connection horizontal document strip with a persistent Data tab and independently closable Query and Structure tabs.
components.css: .ds-document-tabs { height: 36px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 9px; display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 3px; overflow-x: auto; background: #111318; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f232b; } .ds-document-tab { height: 31px; padding: 0 11px; display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #111318; color: #94a3b8; border: 1px solid #111318; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; font: 11px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-document-icon, .ds-close-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: currentColor; } .ds-document-tab-active { background: #0a0c10; color: #f1f5f9; border-color: #343b47; } .ds-document-tab-active .ds-document-icon { color: #3b82f6; } .ds-document-tab span { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-close-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-document-tab:hover span { background: #171a20; color: #ef4444; } .ds-document-tab:focus-visible, .ds-document-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-document-add { width: 26px; height: 26px; margin-bottom: 2px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; background: transparent; color: #94a3b8; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-document-add:hover { background: #10294d; color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: Foreign-key Structure Row
components.description: Dense structure-document row showing a constraint name and local columns beside its qualified reference target and actions.

orders_customer_id_fkeycustomer_id

components.css: .ds-fk-row { min-height: 44px; padding: 7px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; background: #0a0c10; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f232b; font: 11px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fk-row > div { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-fk-row > div:last-child { align-items: end; text-align: right; } .ds-fk-row strong { overflow: hidden; color: #f1f5f9; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; } .ds-fk-row b { overflow: hidden; color: #3b82f6; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 400; } .ds-fk-row small { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 10px; } .ds-fk-row > div:last-child small { font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview:
DBX is an operator's cockpit: a compact, near-black workbench where database identity, navigation, data, and row context stay simultaneously visible. The supplied DBX logo asset anchors rail and top-bar identity. It uses crisp one-pixel separators, small label-first typography, and a restrained blue action language to make a large amount of state immediately scannable instead of decorative.

The interface is intentionally native and dense. Surfaces are layered only enough to establish panes; the visual rhythm comes from alignment, a four-pixel spacing scale, and compact controls. Green is health, amber is work-in-progress or caution, and red is reserved for destructive actions. SQL is the one place where a broader semantic spectrum earns its space. While disconnected, database-only rail controls remain hidden rather than unavailable.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent context: a 46px app rail, 42px top bar, 26px status bar, and visible explorer/inspector panes.
Deliberate density: 10–12px operational text, 30–36px controls, and four-pixel spacing increments.
Blue is an interaction locator, not a decorative fill; it marks active navigation and primary commit actions.
Borders and tonal planes, rather than shadows, separate work areas.
Embedded 16px SVG line icons and per-connection document tabs keep native work context compact and portable.
Connection setup gives Details and Connection String equal weight; Details exposes host, port, user, password, and database, while SQLite uses a native file chooser.
Test Connection validates current input without saving, opening a workspace, or changing database state; saved names identify profiles and OS-keyring lookups.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Use Command Blue to identify an action or current location; never use it as a general panel fill.

rules.name: The Label-First Rule
rules.body: State the object or mode in a compact muted label, then reserve brighter text for actionable or selected content.

rules.name: The Earned Separation Rule
rules.body: Add a new tonal plane only when it clarifies a pane, selection, or transient utility; default content stays on the canvas with a single border boundary.

dos: Do preserve the 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px spacing rhythm and favor 30–36px controls for dense desktop work.
Do keep database context visible through persistent rail, top-level connection tabs, explorer, and status feedback.
Do use the blue active-state system and green connection health consistently across rail, tabs, tables, and connection setup.
Do scope document tabs to their connection and preserve the Data document while Query and Structure documents are independently closable.
Do let narrow layouts hide secondary inspection before shrinking primary data and query work below usable density.
Do keep the DBX logo asset visible in rail and top-bar branding while hiding database-only rail controls until a connection is active.
Do treat Details and Connection String as equal setup modes, use SQLite's native file chooser, and keep Test Connection non-mutating.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, glass effects, oversized cards, or decorative gradients; depth is tonal and border-led.
Don't use blue as ambient decoration or apply semantic success/warning/danger colors without a state meaning.
Don't wrap multi-connection tabs into ambiguous rows; retain horizontal scrolling and concise metadata.
Don't repeat an active PostgreSQL schema prefix in explorer table labels; retain qualification only in the All view.
Don't replace the authored geometric icon vocabulary with emoji, mixed icon sets, or browser-shaped controls.
Don't save a password in profile JSON or use Test Connection to persist, open, or change a database.
